label: Keyboard
depicts: Keyboard panel with six upper key dots above one long lower bar
use_when: Use when the interface wants a keyboard panel with dot keys above one long bottom bar.
avoid_when: Do not use for the wired keyboard when the top should grow one cable curl and the keys become lines.

label: Keyboard
depicts: Keyboard panel with two horizontal key bars and one cable curl above
use_when: Use when the interface wants a keyboard panel with line keys and a small cable curl above it.
avoid_when: Do not use for the key dot keyboard when the upper keys should remain dot shaped.

label: Lantern
depicts: Round lantern frame with one centered inner leaf and two lower tassel lines
use_when: Use when the interface wants a rounded lantern with an inner leaf form and tassels below.
avoid_when: Do not use for the tall lantern when the body should stretch into vertical bars.

label: Lantern
depicts: Tall lantern frame with three vertical bars and two lower tassel lines
use_when: Use when the interface wants a vertical lantern built from tall inner bar segments.
avoid_when: Do not use for the round lantern when the body should wrap around one leaf shaped center.

label: Laptop
depicts: Laptop screen frame above one straight base line
use_when: Use when the interface wants a laptop with a flat base line under the open screen frame.
avoid_when: Do not use for the curved base laptop when the lower platform should bow upward.
